verdict.rationale: Langfuse is explicitly open source (MIT license) and documents multiple self-hosting paths — Docker Compose for local/testing, and Kubernetes/Helm, AWS/Azure/GCP Terraform for production — running the same infrastructure as Langfuse Cloud, with all core features free and unlimited. Community evidence corroborates real-world self-hosted OSS usage (15+ months, praised as best-in-class). Missing for 10: independent audit of self-host feature parity beyond docs, and some enterprise features (RBAC, audit logs) require a paid license key, a minor caveat to full openness.
